title: The Bank of Korea warns rising bonuses at some South Korean chipmakers could fuel broader wage growth and consumer spending, complicating the inflation outlook (Heesu Lee/Bloomberg)
summary: Heesu Lee / Bloomberg: The Bank of Korea warns rising bonuses at some South Korean chipmakers could fuel broader wage growth and consumer spending, complicating the inflation outlook — South Korea's artificial intelligence-driven semiconductor boom may wind up complicating the inflation outlook …
